about_the_game:
Welcome to Pacific West, an old Western village cut off from the rest of the world. Here, there are no firearms... but be warned—this place is filled with traitors and some pretty wild traps.
But who will you play as?

The Sheriff

The Sheriff is the boss of the town. His job is to keep peace and order throughout Pacific West. But he must stay alert—some people are out to get him.
Protect yourself, sabotage traps, and most importantly, lock up the town’s troublemakers!

The Bandits

Their objective is simple: eliminate the Sheriff!
But first, they must avoid being caught and identified. Bandits have a series of tasks that lead to the creation of often deadly traps.
Stay hidden... or become master bluffers.

The Deputies

As a Deputy, your job is to prove your loyalty to the Sheriff.
Protect him and help uncover the parasites lurking in town.

The Renegade

A true wild card.
The Renegade can side with the Sheriff... or try to take his place. To do so, the Renegade must first ensure all the Bandits are imprisoned—then eliminate the Sheriff and seize control.

Suspicion, Betrayal, Cooperation... Will the Sheriff of Pacific West be overthrown?

Gameplay Mechanics and Details

  • Proximity voice chat allowing real-time conversations—building trust... or betrayal.

  • Task/Objective system:
    Each player has missions. Bandits work to set traps. The Sheriff and his Deputies aim to sabotage them.
    The Renegade can choose tasks that serve the good—or the bad.

  • Short or long rounds, with 4 to 8 players. Perfect for game nights with friends.

Make every game a unique adventure... and find out who among your friends is the best liar—or the most loyal ally.
